text: Given the connector is running, When a client sends tools/list with a valid credential header, Then the response includes exactly the 4 digitalocean_inference_* tools named in the tech design's Data & API contract table, each with a first-line description <= 100 chars and full description <= 500 chars

Given a tools/call request with no X-DigitalOcean-Api-Token header, When any Inference tool is invoked, Then the response is HTTP 401 listing the required header, and the upstream inference.do-ai.run client is never called

Given a valid token and a mocked GET /v1/models response with 3 models, When digitalocean_inference_list_models is called, Then it returns the 3 models with id/created/owned_by fields and the tool is annotated readOnlyHint: true

Given a valid token, a catalog model id, and a mocked POST /v1/chat/completions response, When digitalocean_inference_create_chat_completion is called, Then it returns the assistant message content, finish_reason, and usage

Given a mocked upstream 400/404 response for an unknown model id, When digitalocean_inference_create_chat_completion is called, Then it returns a structured error carrying DigitalOcean's own message, not a generic failure or an HTTP 500

Given a valid token and a mocked POST /v1/embeddings response for a 2-item input array, When digitalocean_inference_create_embedding is called, Then it returns 2 embedding vectors, one per input, plus token usage

Given a valid token and a mocked POST /v1/images/generations response, When digitalocean_inference_generate_image is called, Then it returns the generated image data and revised_prompt when present, and the tool's description states it is not read-only

Given a mocked upstream 429 response with a Retry-After header, When any Inference tool is called, Then the client retries with backoff honoring Retry-After within the bounded retry budget; if still 429 after retries, Then the agent sees a structured rate_limited error, not a bare timeout

Given a mocked upstream 401 response (valid MSPbots header, invalid DigitalOcean token), When any Inference tool is called, Then the agent sees a structured unauthorized error distinct from TC2's not_configured (missing MSPbots header)

Given two concurrent tools/call requests carrying two different tenants' X-DigitalOcean-Api-Token values (A and B), When both complete, Then neither response contains data retrieved using the other request's token -- verified by asserting no shared mutable state keyed only by in-process globals

Given the repository's README.md, Then it documents the X-DigitalOcean-Api-Token header (purpose, how to obtain either a Personal Access Token or a Model Access Key), lists all 4 Inference tools in its tool table, and its MSPbots Connector section is byte-for-byte identical to the skill's reference/readme-connector-section.md

Given a real DigitalOcean account token and an unknown/invalid model id, When digitalocean_inference_create_chat_completion is called against the live API, Then the real error shape (status code, id/message fields) confirms or corrects the assumed 400/404 -> invalid_argument/not_found mapping in the tech design's Data & API contract section
steps: Obtain a real DigitalOcean Personal Access Token or Model Access Key
Start the connector locally with the real token in X-DigitalOcean-Api-Token
Call tools/call digitalocean_inference_create_chat_completion with a model id that does not exist on the account, e.g. "does-not-exist-123"
expect: The real HTTP status and error body match (or are used to correct) the tech design's assumed mapping; the connector surfaces it as a structured invalid_argument or not_found error, not a 500
notes: needs a real vendor account; recorded as pending in the Self-test report, not blocking per mcp-track.md section 3 ("no test account is not a blocker")
